Dann könnte eila dein nächstes Level sein. Dafür suchen wir Menschen, die Verantwortung übernehmen und Dinge ins Rollen bringen. Du verantwortest die Einsatzplanung unserer mobilen Eventunits und Fahrzeuge. Du steuerst Logistikpartner, Dienstleister, Locations und externe Gewerke. Du organisierst Routen, Zeitpläne, Hotels, Transfers und alle operativen Abläufe rund um die Tour. Du sorgst dafür, dass Equipment, Material und Crew zur richtigen Zeit am richtigen Ort sind. Du bist Ansprechpartner für Kunden, Projektteams und Partner. Du behältst Qualität, Sicherheit, Termine und Budgets jederzeit im Blick. Du unterstützt aktiv bei Auf- und Abbauten DAS BRINGST DU MIT CE-Führerschein und sichere Fahrpraxis. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Hohe Reisebereitschaft innerhalb Europas. Erfahrung im Roadshow-Umfeld Organisationsstärke, Belastbarkeit und eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität. Technisches Verständnis und Freude an komplexen Projekten. Die Fähigkeit, auch unter Zeitdruck strukturiert und lösungsorientiert zu arbeiten. WAS DU WOANDERS VIELLEICHT VERMISST Die Königsklasse der Roadshows Bei uns koordinierst du nicht irgendeine Tour. Du arbeitest an Projekten, die europaweit sichtbar sind und mit mobilen Erlebniswelten Maßstäbe setzen. Echte Verantwortung Kurze Entscheidungswege. Keine endlosen Abstimmungsschleifen. Du übernimmst Verantwortung und gestaltest aktiv mit. Ein Team, das anpackt Bei eila sitzt niemand auf der Ersatzbank. Wir arbeiten Schulter an Schulter und ziehen gemeinsam Projekte durch, auf die wir stolz sind. Internationale Spielwiese Europa wird zu deinem Arbeitsplatz. Kein Tag ist wie der andere. Keine Tour wie die nächste. DEINE EILA VORTEILE Was wir ​sonst so noch bieten: Zukunftssicherer Arbeitsplatz in einem wachsenden Unternehmen Moderne Arbeitsumgebung Flache Hierarchien und schnelle Entscheidungen Firmenfitness BusinessBike Ein Team, das Zusammenhalt nicht predigt, sondern lebt Bereit für die Pole Position? Werde Teil der eila-Family – wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung! Schick uns deine Unterlagen ganz unkompliziert per E-Mail oder über unser Portal. Wir sind gespannt darauf, dich kennenzulernen!

review_candidates.title: REGIONAL KEY ACCOUNT SERVICE ENGINEER – SOUTHERN BULGARIA
review_candidates.description: THIS POSITION REQUIRES CURRENT RESIDENCY IN PLOVDIV PROVINCE AND NATIVE-LEVEL BULGARIAN Stabil Engineering is expanding its team across the country and is looking for a Regional Key Account Service Engineer to join us and support the maintenance and development of equipment at our customers' sites in Southern Bulgaria . Stabil Engineering is a trading and engineering company and a leader on the Bulgarian market in the design, implementation and maintenance of complete solutions for product identification, product inspection and labeling. We are the official Bulgarian representative of global leaders such as Markem-Imaje, METTLER TOLEDO and HERMA and have integrated more than 2,500 machines into production lines for companies such as Coca-Cola, Gorna Bania, Hissar, Mondelēz, Bella, Nestlé, Chipita, Prestige, Actavis, Aroma, Sopharma, Ital Food, Ficosota, Linkin and many others. Our work combines engineering, technology and practical work in real production environments. We constantly strive to improve our customers' processes and invest in the knowledge, skills and development of our people. As part of our StabilX customer partnership model , we aim to be much more than a technology and service provider. We work alongside our customers, understand their production environment and challenges, and combine engineering expertise with responsive service and long-term support. For the Key Account Service Engineer , this means not only solving technical issues but becoming a trusted technical partner who helps customers maintain reliable production and continuously improve their operations. WHO ARE WE LOOKING FOR? Our Regional Key Account Service Engineer is a technically skilled, customer-oriented professional who is comfortable working independently and as part of a sales and engineering team. The role requires strong problem-solving and communication skills, good organization and the ability to prioritize tasks while maintaining a practical, solution-focused approach. A key part of the position is building long-term relationships with strategic customers and acting as a trusted technical contact, supporting equipment reliability, preventive maintenance and further development. The position involves regular travel within Southern Bulgaria and direct work at customer production facilities.   KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Key account technical support: Maintain direct and continuous technical support for key customers in Southern Bulgaria, ensuring high equipment uptime, reliable operation and strong customer satisfaction. Serve as the primary technical point of contact, advising customers on machine operation, maintenance planning and risk prevention. Service and maintenance: Perform installation, commissioning, preventive and corrective maintenance and servicing of industrial equipment at customer production facilities. Troubleshooting and technical support: Diagnose and resolve technical issues on-site, identify potential technical risks and coordinate with the national maintenance team when additional expertise or support is required. Customer training and partnership: Provide technical guidance and training to operators, maintenance personnel and engineering teams. Build long-term customer relationships and contribute to their development in line with the StabilX approach. Technical documentation: Work with technical manuals, schematics and service instructions and prepare accurate service reports, maintenance records and documentation related to machines, spare parts and consumables. Cooperation with sales: Work closely with the Regional Sales Manager to identify service-related opportunities, support business development and strengthen strategic customer partnerships.   REQUIREMENTS FOR THE POSITION Technical preparation: Higher technical education in a relevant field and at least 2 years of professional experience in maintenance, servicing or commissioning of industrial equipment. Previous experience in a customer-facing technical role or supporting key industrial customers will be considered an advantage. Technical thinking: Strong technical understanding and ability to understand machine operation, diagnose technical problems, identify root causes and find practical and effective solutions. Technical documentation and technologies: Good working knowledge of technical English and confidence working with technical manuals, schematics, catalogs and service instructions. Good computer literacy and ability to work with specialized software and web-based systems. Communication and customer orientation: Clear and professional communication skills, ability to build trust with customers and work effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to work independently while cooperating effectively with sales and technical teams. Personal qualities: Responsibility, initiative, adaptability, good organization and prioritization skills, and motivation for continuous professional development. Mobility: Valid driving license (Category B) and readiness for regular business travel. WHAT THE COMPANY OFFERS Remuneration and bonuses: Competitive fixed remuneration and a bonus system linked to achieved results. Training and career development: In-depth onboarding and product training, access to structured professional development programs and opportunities for career growth. Working time and leave: Flexible working day with the possibility to choose your starting and finishing time, as well as additional paid leave for loyal employees. Social benefits: Food vouchers, additional health insurance, Multisport card at a preferential price and a bonus upon the birth of a child. Team and corporate environment: Work with experienced professionals and opportunities to participate in team-building activities, volunteering initiatives and other corporate activities at Stabil Engineering and Stabil Group. HOW TO APPLY If what you have read matches your professional interests and you are looking for an opportunity to develop your career in the field of industrial technology and engineering, send us your application. Only shortlisted candidates will be invited to an interview. STABIL ENGINEERING Ltd. guarantees the confidentiality of the information provided in accordance with applicable personal data protection legislation.

In unserem familiengeführten Unternehmen arbeitest du in respektvoller Umgebung. Du hast Lust auf neue Herausforderungen, packst gerne mit an und schätzt die Abwechslung von Service-Einsätzen? Willkommen bei PlanET! Deine Aufgaben Du betreust unsere Kreditorenbuchhaltung. Das Reisekostenmanagement liegt in deinem Verantwortungsbereich und die weitere Digitalisierung der Prozesse treibst du aktiv voran. Kontenabstimmungen im Umfeld von Kreditoren und Reisekosten führst du eigenständig durch. Bei Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen nach HGB unterstützt du dein Team. Die Mitwirkung an Projekten zur Optimierung von Prozessen und Abläufen im Rechnungswesen gehört ebenfalls dazu. Auswertungen, Reports und Statistiken erstellst du regelmäßig für unterschiedliche Ansprechpersonen. Dein Profil Eine abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung, zum Beispiel als Industriekaufmann (m/w/d), Steuerfachangestellter (m/w/d) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation, bildet die Grundlage. Idealerweise konntest du bereits drei bis vier Jahre Erfahrung in der Finanzbuchhaltung sammeln. Grundkenntnisse in der Buchführung nach HGB sowie Interesse an bilanznahen Themen bringst du mit. Im Umgang mit MS Office und ERP-Systemen wie SAP, Navision oder DATEV fühlst du dich sicher. Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse und solide Englischkenntnisse runden dein fachliches Profil ab. Eine strukturierte, sorgfältige und selbstständige Arbeitsweise ist für dich selbstverständlich. Teamgeist, Flexibilität und die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen, machen dich aus. Ganze 30 Tage Urlaub im Jahr, um die Welt zu bereisen oder einfach mal gemütlich zuhause abzuhängen! Bei uns hast du die Chance, dich weiterzubilden, bis dir die Synapsen rauchen! Egal, ob hauseigene Sprachlehrer oder abgefahrene externe Schulungen – wir bringen dich auf das nächste Level. Energie tanken leicht gemacht! Wir haben zahlreiche Angebote, um deinen Körper und Geist in Schwung zu bringen! Unser Team ist mehr als nur ein Team. Wir sind eine Familie! Wir feiern zusammen, powern uns bei Teambuildingmaßnahmen aus und rocken Events wie den Dodgeball Beach Cup jedes Jahr! review_candidates.title: Mission Sales Director - Greece, Balkans and Eastern Mediterranean
review_candidates.description: Role Highlights Missions Sales Director Location: Greece Department: Missions Sales Reports to: VP of Mission Sales, with a dotted line to local CEO Employment type: Permanent Workplace model: Remote Employment is subject to applicable security screening. Why This Role Matters As a Missions Sales Director, you’ll lead sovereign satellite and ISR mission sales to government customers across Greece, Balkans and Eastern Mediterranean region, driving growth, trust, and long-term partnerships that advance ICEYE’s position as the defence-focused space ISR leader. You will own the full sales cycle for Missions satellite programmes, from identifying and shaping opportunities to closing multi-year deals. By building strategic relationships with governments and key decision-makers, you will expand ICEYE’s presence in the region, deliver sustainable revenue growth, and ensure customer success through close collaboration across ICEYE’s Missions and Data lines of business. Who We Are ICEYE is the world leader in sovereign intelligence from space. We deliver persistent monitoring capabilities to detect and respond to changes in any location on Earth. ICEYE owns the world's largest and most advanced SAR (synthetic aperture radar) satellite constellation. To our customers we provide intelligence with unmatched quality, latency and revisit times, in any weather, day or night. To governments who choose to operate their own constellation we provide this proven capability as a sovereign system. ICEYE-built constellations serve customers in defence and intelligence, environmental monitoring, insurance and emergency management. We enable fast decisions that contribute to a safer future. Founded and headquartered in Finland, ICEYE operates globally with over 1000 employees across Europe, North America, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific. Day-to-day Responsibilities Own and drive regional revenue growth for ICEYE’s Missions business in your dedicated region Identify, shape, qualify, and close sovereign satellite and ISR mission opportunities with government customers. Build and sustain trusted relationships with government stakeholders, defence organisations, and key decision-makers in the market. Develop and manage a qualified sales pipeline, including capture plans, win strategies, and accurate forecasting. Lead complex strategic sales processes, including opportunity reviews, bid or no-bid decisions, proposal coordination, and commercial positioning. Collaborate across ICEYE’s Missions and Data lines of business to align customer needs, technical capabilities, and delivery plans. Represent ICEYE in-market through customer meetings, industry events, and strategic stakeholder engagement. Maintain strong CRM discipline and provide clear market intelligence to support business planning and decision-making. Must Haves What we’re looking for 5+ years of strategic sales or business development experience in the aerospace, defence, space, ISR, earth observation, or related government technology sector. 5+ years of international sales or export experience with complex solutions. Experience selling to government customers, defence organisations, or public sector decision-makers. Existing network across relevant government and government-related organisations across Greece, Balkans and Eastern Mediterranean. Strong understanding of earth observation, ISR, or satellite-based capabilities, ideally including SAR. Proven ability to run complex sales cycles, including lead qualification, opportunity development, capture planning, stakeholder mapping, and deal closure. Professional working proficiency in Greek Willingness to travel as required, primarily across the region and to Finland. Nice To Haves Previous military, defence, intelligence, or security-sector experience. Experience producing capture plans and delivering against win strategies. Track record of closing value-based sales with a strong focus on customer success. Experience leading multi-department sales pursuits, gate reviews, bid processes, and competitive analysis. Experience using Salesforce or another CRM. Sales training in Miller Heiman, Korn Ferry, Shipley, or a similar methodology. Application Process Assessment Recruiter interview Peer interview VP interview References CEO interview Working at ICEYE At ICEYE, you’ll join a diverse and highly engaged team united by the ambition to make the impossible possible. As a global scale-up, we combine speed and ambition with the opportunity to take real ownership from day one. Your growth, wellbeing, and success are a priority, with continuous professional development, training opportunities, and a culture where collaboration is how we win. How We Work (Our Values) Make the impossible possible: We set ambitious goals and stay calm under pressure. We bring grit, optimism, and ownership when things get hard, and we keep moving until we find a way. Be curious: Go deep, ask questions, listen carefully, and think critically. Understand the “why” behind decisions. See the big picture: Stay close to what’s happening across the company so you can make better decisions. Consider how your work affects others. Drive effective teamwork: Create psychological safety, invite different perspectives, and build inclusive teams. There are no bad questions. Act as one team: We win together. We match tasks to the right owner and stay agile as priorities shift. Have fun: What we do matters and it should be enjoyable. Celebrate progress, take pride in results, and share the wins. Benefits Our benefits are designed to support your health and wellbeing, at work and beyond. We keep improving them based on employee feedback, and offerings vary by location. Talent Acquisition will confirm what applies for this role and location during the process. Base salary range for this position is 100 000 - 150 000 EUR per year, gross, dependent on experience, and will be negotiated individually. Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion We want ICEYE to be a place where people can be themselves and do great work. Different backgrounds and perspectives make us stronger, which is why we work to create an environment where people feel included, respected, and able to speak up. Whatever your background, we want you to bring your authentic self to the table. We’re committed to fair, inclusive hiring and equal opportunity. Everyone is welcome to apply. If you need any adjustments or support during the recruitment process, tell us and we’ll do our best to help. Apply now to start your ICEYE journey, and help us continue to make the impossible possible together. Read more about ICEYE and working with us at iceye.com.

review_candidates.title: Marketing Specialist (Content)
review_candidates.description: About Flexport: At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That’s why it’s our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We’re shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes - from emerging brands to Fortune 500s - use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. Marketing Specialist (content) About Us We’re shaping the future of global business through high-converting content, high-impact experiences, and smart technology. Supported by a passionate, fast-moving team, we solve real-world industry challenges across EMEA. Ready to bring dynamic ideas to life? Come join us! The Opportunity We’re looking for a Marketing Specialist to power our EMEA content and digital marketing engine. In this role, you'll create and repurpose content across formats and channels, from social posts and email campaigns to webinars, while also producing content that brings our events to life. Ideal for an ambitious marketer (1–2 years of experience) who combines strong writing instincts, tech curiosity (GenAI), and creative storytelling. What You’ll Do Content Creation & Storytelling Content Creation & Repurposing: Create new content pieces and turn long-form content into fresh formats (social posts, infographics, short-form video) and maintain our content library, and keep an SEO lens on written content. Flexport Storytelling: Interview clients to craft compelling success stories and testimonials. Work with subject matter experts across the business to keep an eye on market trends and turn them into timely content, and support Product Marketing with launch content and collateral.. Social & Digital: Own organic social media execution and manage our email newsletter and nurture flows. Sales Alignment: Partner with Sales and Business Development to ensure content gets used effectively across the funnel, and support sales with enablement collateral. Content Performance: Track and report on content performance (engagement, distribution, funnel impact) Events Content & Digital Event Content: Produce the content that brings our events to life, from promotional social and email campaigns to on-site recap content, for conferences, roundtables, and webinars across EMEA. Webinars: Support production of our monthly webinar series, including promotion and supporting content. What You Bring 1–2 years experience in marketing or content roles (internships welcome). Multilingual: Near-native English plus fluency in French, German, Spanish, or Italian would be a plus. A Passion for Content: You love writing, repurposing content across formats, and telling stories on social media. Creative & Tech-Savvy: Sharp copywriting, design/video skills (Canva), and hands-on experience with GenAI tools (ChatGPT/Claude/Gemini). Organized & Flexible: Strong project management skills to juggle multiple content workstreams, plus occasional event support, in a fast-paced environment. Plus: Experience with Salesforce and Pardot (Marketing Cloud Account Engagement). What we offer: An opportunity to contribute to one of the fastest-growing companies, where you’ll have the chance to create a global impact while being a part of a thriving multinational environment Daily catered lunches incl. vegetarian options, breakfast, snacks and soft drinks available in our office on daily basis Commute expenses: Flexport will cover home-office commuting costs for employees living outside of Amsterdam Amazing office in the heart of Amsterdam. 25 working days as vacation days based on full time employment. Health insurance: Flexport offers a collective health insurance plan including a basic package and any available additional packages. Your monthly premium is fully paid by Flexport. A defined pension contribution scheme Equity program: every team member becomes a shareholder, aligning our success with yours. As a private company in a multi-trillion dollar industry, you have a direct stake in our collective growth and success. Employee Assistance Program through Aetna Resources for Living: Flexport provides an employer-sponsored program at no cost to you and your household members Parental leave benefit: Flexport is here to support you and your families in one of the most important times in life – the birth of a child! Our parental leave program allows both mothers and partners to take time off from work for pregnancy, childbirth, and to bond with your new child. Commitment to Equal Opportunity At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

review_candidates.description: GUT is an award-winning global creative network powered by Globant. We bring together creativity, technology, and AI to shape the future of marketing, partnering with leading global brands to create ideas that move people and drive business growth. With a diverse and passionate team across multiple countries, we’re redefining how creativity and innovation work together to transform the industry, one brave idea at a time. GUT Copenhagen is focused on mainly Pharma and Healthtech. About the Role: This role is the backbone of our operations, ensuring the right people are working on the right projects at the right time. You will partner closely with Account Management, Creative, Strategy, and Project Management teams to balance workloads, protect deadlines, and keep projects moving efficiently from brief to delivery. Key Responsibilities: Manage the end-to-end traffic and resourcing process across all active accounts and projects Based on brief from Head of Departments, build and update overview of client-specific teams within each department and make project staffing decisions based on that in coordination with Project Managers. Build and maintain resource schedules, allocating creative, strategy, and production staff based on skillset, capacity, and project priority Own the agency's traffic system/workflow tool (e.g., Workbook / COR), keeping timelines and statuses up to date Identify resourcing conflicts, capacity gaps, or bottlenecks early and proactively propose solutions Facilitate daily/weekly status meetings (stand-ups, traffic meetings) with Creative, Strategy, and Account teams Track project timelines against deadlines and flag risks to Account/Project Management Partner with Finance/Project Management on freelancer and overtime forecasting when internal capacity is constrained Maintain visibility into team utilization rates and provide regular capacity reports to leadership Support onboarding of new projects by translating briefs into actionable task assignments and timelines Continuously improve traffic processes, tools, and templates to increase efficiency Handle capacity and staffing tasks in internal systems. Own the freelancer search, onboarding processes & documentation, and overall communication. Requirements & Qualifications: 3+ years of experience in a resource management, traffic, or project coordination role within an advertising, marketing, or creative agency Strong understanding of creative and production workflows (design, copy, video, digital, social) Experience with resource/traffic management or project management software Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and shifting priorities Strong communication and negotiation skills; comfortable pushing back on unrealistic timelines Detail-oriented with a proactive, problem-solving mindset Ability to stay calm under pressure in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment Nice to Have: Familiarity with agency financial/billing processes (job costing, budgets, freelancer POs) Experience supporting integrated marketing campaigns (digital, social, video, print) Background in Agency Operations or Project Management. This job can be filled in Copenhagan . GUT is a business unit within Globant, operating as its creative and marketing division. All services are provided within the framework of Globant’s corporate governance, policies, and legal entities, as applicable in each jurisdiction. Create with us digital products that people love. We will bring businesses and consumers together through AI technology and creativity, driving digital transformation to impact the world positively. We may use AI and machine learning technologies in our recruitment process. Globant is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. Globant is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

review_candidates.title: Manager, Investor Relations
review_candidates.description: Finnair is a diverse community of professionals who work ambitiously with a big heart and commitment. A strong safety culture is our priority and at the core of our everyday work, never taking it for granted. We are committed to doing our share in solving the climate challenge by determinedly following our science-based pathway to decarbonize our operations. We find meaning in our purpose: With our heart in Finland, we make every journey better, today and tomorrow. Our values – Always Safe, Customer at Heart and Stronger Together – guide us in everything we do. We are now looking for a MANAGER, INVESTOR RELATIONS to join our team! The Manager, Investor Relations supports the IR Director in preparing financial communications, including earnings releases, annual reports, stock exchange releases, and investor presentations. The role also coordinates conference calls and investor meetings, assists in responding to analysts and shareholder inquiries, and helps ensure a clear and accurate understanding of Finnair’s financial performance and strategy to support fair valuation of the company. Main Responsibilities Include, For Example Day-to-day IR tasks. Drafting interim and annual reports. Drafting process of regulated releases (stock exchange releases and investor news) according to market regulations. Interaction with private investors Acting as a contact point with institutional investors and analysts. Our Expectations Minimum 3 years of relevant work experience, preferably in a listed company. Bachelor’s or master’s degree from a relevant field or equivalent practical experience. Knowledge of the financial markets and regulations for exchange listed companies. Possessing analytical skills with the ability to interpret and assess financial statements and related data is an advantage. High level of accuracy, attention to detail, and commitment to producing consistent, high-quality work. Collaborative mindset and strong interpersonal skills Excellent cross-functional communication and team working skills. Fluent Finnish and English language skills, both spoken and written. Working at Finnair: We offer you an exciting opportunity to work in the fast-changing aviation and international travel industry in a culture that drives and enables professional development and continuous improvement. You will be supported by internally highly rated supervisory work with modern leadership practices that we constantly develop. We are happy to enable our employees to enrich their lives and fulfill their travel dreams by offering a wide leisure travel benefit. We also support the health and wellbeing of our employees through our own Sickness Fund insurance benefit, Epassi sport (culture, health & wellbeing or commuting benefit), gyms around the Finnair campus and activities organized by our hobby clubs. Are you ready for the challenge and excited to join our team? Submit your application with your CV, cover letter, and salary expectation as soon as possible, but no later than Wednesday, 30 September 2026. We kindly ask that your cover letter be submitted in Finnish, while your CV may be in either Finnish or English. Please note that the hiring process includes a pre-employment security clearance and a drug test. For more information , please contact Sophie Jolly (IR Director) by phone +358 40 828 7317 on the specified hours stated below (EEST): Monday, 21 September, from 11am to 12pm Friday, 25 September between 11am to 12pm Please note that we do not process applications submitted via email. Our people are key to our success and the foundation that makes Finnair unique. We are committed to creating a safe work environment where all our people can thrive and succeed. We cherish diversity and strive to employ people with different backgrounds and experiences, to bring together multiple views to foster our business success. According to our employee survey, respecting diversity is at a high level in our work community. You are welcome to join Finnair as your authentic self.
